name: Hermes Agent
author: apple050620312@users.noreply.github.com
description: Nous Research Hermes Agent for Pterodactyl. Runs the persistent gateway and an optional authenticated dashboard. All configuration, memory, sessions, and skills are stored in /home/container.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo 'Hermes is bundled in the runtime image; no server files need to be downloaded.'

variables.name: Model provider
variables.description: Hermes provider name, for example openrouter, anthropic, openai, google, deepseek, xai, nous, or custom. Used only when config.yaml does not exist yet.

variables.name: Model name
variables.description: Provider model ID. Used only when config.yaml does not exist yet; later changes can be made in the dashboard or config.yaml.

variables.name: Custom model base URL
variables.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Usually used with provider=custom and OPENAI_API_KEY.

variables.name: OpenRouter API key
variables.description: Recommended credential when MODEL_PROVIDER is openrouter.

variables.name: OpenAI / custom endpoint API key
variables.description: Credential for OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible custom endpoint.

variables.name: Telegram bot token
variables.description: Optional token from @BotFather. Supplying it enables Telegram.

variables.name: Telegram allowed users
variables.description: Comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs. Hermes denies all Telegram users when no allowlist is configured.

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: Optional Discord bot token. Supplying it enables Discord.

variables.name: Discord allowed users
variables.description: Comma-separated Discord user IDs. Hermes denies all Discord users when no allowlist is configured.

variables.name: Enable dashboard
variables.description: Starts the authenticated Hermes dashboard on the server's primary allocation.

variables.name: Dashboard password
variables.description: Leave blank to generate a strong password on first start and save it as .dashboard-password in Files.

variables.name: Enable OpenAI-compatible API
variables.description: Optional. If enabled, add an allocation matching API server port and set an API key of at least 8 characters.

variables.name: API server port
variables.description: Internal API port. Add the same port as an allocation when API_SERVER_ENABLED=true.

variables.name: API server key
variables.description: Bearer token for the OpenAI-compatible API. Required when the API server is enabled; use at least 8 characters.

variables.name: API CORS origins
variables.description: Comma-separated allowed browser origins. Keep blank unless browser access is required; avoid * on public deployments.

variables.name: API bind host
variables.description: Required for access through a Pterodactyl allocation.
